label: No Inherited Special Ability
description: The character expresses no inherited bloodline trait.

label: Dormant Inherited Trait
description: An inherited trait exists but is not awakened.

label: Clan Technique Affinity
description: Natural aptitude for a clan's signature techniques (not a Kekkei Genkai).

label: Verified Kekkei Genkai
description: A confirmed bloodline limit passed down genetically.

label: Verified Kekkei Tota
description: Extremely rare advanced bloodline combination where lore supports it.

label: Dojutsu Inheritance
description: Inherited eye ability, subject to separate Dojutsu validation.

label: OC Inherited Ability
description: Original inherited ability, explicitly labeled OC.
